description: The agent must: (1) Read the transcript and identify the product stage as '已有用户无付费' (has users, no paying customers), which per the skill's 六问逼问法 means focusing on Q2, Q4, Q5 rather than all six questions. (2) Execute Phase 3: generate explicit premises in the '[陈述] — 同意/不同意？' format. (3) Execute Phase 4: generate at least 方案A and 方案B using the required schema with 工作量 (S/M/L/XL), 风险 (低/中/高), 优势, 劣势, and 复用 fields; one plan must be minimum viable. (4) Execute Phase 5 using the Startup template (not Builder) with all 12 required sections including '我注意到的你的思维方式' which MUST contain verbatim quotes from the transcript (e.g. '张律师', '实习生', '民事借贷', '本周'). (5) Write ZERO code — only a design document. The key proprietary traps are: the S/M/L/XL workload scale (not story points or days), the 低/中/高 risk scale, the verbatim-quote requirement in 观察反射 (not paraphrase), and the stage-based question selection logic.
